description: Samsung Galaxy phones and tablets running One UI.

packages.name: Bixby Voice
packages.breaks: Bixby voice commands stop. The side key can be reassigned in Settings.

packages.name: Bixby voice wake-up
packages.breaks: 'Hi Bixby' no longer wakes the assistant.

packages.name: Samsung Free
packages.what: News and media page left of the home screen.
packages.breaks: The Samsung Free page disappears.

packages.name: Game Launcher
packages.breaks: Game Launcher disappears; games still open from the home screen.

packages.name: Tips
packages.breaks: Only this app goes away until it is switched back on.

packages.name: Samsung Members
packages.breaks: Samsung Members and its phone diagnostics are unavailable.

packages.name: Samsung Kids installer
packages.breaks: Samsung Kids cannot be set up.

packages.name: Samsung Kids
packages.breaks: Samsung Kids mode is unavailable.

packages.name: AR Doodle
packages.breaks: Only this app goes away until it is switched back on.

packages.name: AR Zone
packages.breaks: AR Zone disappears from the camera.

packages.name: AR Emoji stickers
packages.what: Stickers made from your AR Emoji.
packages.breaks: AR Emoji stickers disappear from the keyboard.

packages.name: Deco Pic
packages.breaks: Only this app goes away until it is switched back on.

packages.name: Galaxy Friends
packages.breaks: Themed accessory cases no longer change the phone's theme.

packages.name: Samsung Global Goals
packages.breaks: Only this app goes away until it is switched back on.

packages.name: Samsung TV Plus
packages.breaks: Only this app goes away until it is switched back on.

packages.name: Link Sharing
packages.what: Shares large files as a link.
packages.breaks: The Link Sharing option disappears from the share menu.

packages.name: Bixby service
packages.breaks: Bixby features inside other Samsung apps stop working.

packages.name: Bixby Vision
packages.what: Recognises objects and text in the camera and gallery.
packages.breaks: Camera scene suggestions and text-in-photo features may stop.

packages.name: Modes and Routines
packages.what: Automations such as 'when I get home'.
packages.breaks: Your routines and modes stop running.

packages.name: Game Booster
packages.breaks: The in-game toolbar disappears.

packages.name: Samsung Internet
packages.breaks: If it is your default browser, links have nowhere to open until you choose another.

packages.name: Samsung Email
packages.breaks: Mail accounts set up in this app stop notifying you.

packages.name: Samsung Calendar
packages.breaks: No event reminders unless another calendar app is installed.

packages.name: Samsung Calculator
packages.breaks: No calculator unless another one is installed.

packages.name: Samsung Notes
packages.breaks: Your Samsung Notes cannot be opened until it is switched back on.

packages.name: Voice Recorder
packages.breaks: Recordings cannot be played or made in this app.

packages.name: Reminder
packages.breaks: Reminders you set will not alert you.

packages.name: Galaxy Store
packages.breaks: Samsung apps and watch apps stop updating; themes and fonts cannot be bought.

packages.name: Galaxy Themes
packages.breaks: You cannot change theme or icon pack; the current theme stays.

packages.name: Galaxy Wearable
packages.breaks: Galaxy watches and Buds cannot be managed from the phone.

packages.name: AR Emoji
packages.breaks: AR Emoji in the camera and keyboard stops working.

packages.name: Sticker Centre
packages.breaks: Stickers in the Samsung keyboard may disappear.

packages.name: Samsung Wallet
packages.breaks: Paying with Samsung Wallet stops working.

packages.name: SmartThings
packages.breaks: SmartThings devices cannot be controlled; SmartThings Find is affected.

packages.name: SmartThings nearby helper
packages.what: Finds nearby Samsung devices to connect.
packages.breaks: Pop-ups for connecting nearby Samsung devices stop.

packages.name: Digital Wellbeing
packages.breaks: App timers and Bedtime mode stop; the Settings entry breaks.

packages.name: Customisation Service
packages.what: Learns your usage to personalise Samsung apps and ads.
packages.breaks: Personalised suggestions in Samsung apps stop.

packages.name: Link to Windows service
packages.breaks: Phone Link with a Windows PC stops working.

packages.name: Quick Share
packages.breaks: Quick Share stops working.

packages.name: Dual Messenger
packages.what: Runs a second copy of chat apps.
packages.breaks: Second copies of chat apps stop working.

packages.name: Dynamic Lock screen
packages.breaks: Lock-screen wallpaper rotation stops.

packages.name: Samsung Weather
packages.breaks: Weather widgets on the home and lock screen go blank.

packages.name: Smart Switch agent
packages.what: Helps move data from an old phone.
packages.breaks: Smart Switch transfers may fail.

packages.name: Smart Switch assistant
packages.what: Helps move data from an old phone.
packages.breaks: Smart Switch transfers may fail.

packages.name: Samsung voice input
packages.breaks: The microphone button on the Samsung keyboard stops working.

packages.name: Finder
packages.breaks: The search bar in the app drawer stops working.

packages.name: Edge panels

packages.name: Tasks edge panel
packages.breaks: That Edge panel disappears.

packages.name: Clipboard edge panel
packages.breaks: That Edge panel disappears.

packages.name: Apps edge panel
packages.what: App shortcuts panel for Edge panels.
packages.breaks: That Edge panel disappears.

packages.name: People edge panel
packages.breaks: That Edge panel disappears.

packages.name: Device protection
packages.breaks: The 'Device protection' scan in Settings stops working.

packages.name: ANT+ plug-ins
packages.breaks: ANT+ heart-rate straps and bike sensors will not connect.

packages.name: ANT+ server
packages.breaks: ANT+ heart-rate straps and bike sensors will not connect.

packages.name: ANT+ libraries
packages.breaks: ANT+ heart-rate straps and bike sensors will not connect.

packages.name: Game Optimizing Service
packages.what: Manages heat and performance in games.
packages.breaks: Games may overheat the phone or run differently.

packages.name: Samsung Pass
packages.breaks: Saved passwords and biometric sign-in to apps and sites stop working.

packages.name: Samsung Cloud
packages.what: Backup and sync of settings and data.
packages.breaks: Samsung Cloud backup and sync stop.

packages.name: Samsung account
packages.breaks: Samsung account features break: Find My Mobile, Galaxy Store, cloud, Pass.

packages.name: Samsung Experience Service
packages.what: Shared background service for Samsung apps.
packages.breaks: Sharing, Samsung account and several Samsung apps can break.

packages.name: Find My Mobile
packages.what: Locate, lock or erase a lost phone.
packages.breaks: You cannot find or lock the phone if it is lost.

packages.name: Samsung Contacts
packages.breaks: Contacts and parts of the phone app may stop working.

packages.name: Samsung Gallery
packages.breaks: The camera's preview button and photo pickers in other apps may break.

packages.name: My Files
packages.breaks: Opening downloads and attaching files in other apps may break.

packages.name: Samsung Camera
packages.breaks: No camera app; quick-launch and lock-screen camera stop.

packages.name: Wallpaper and style
packages.breaks: You cannot change wallpaper; the Settings entry breaks.

packages.name: Software update
packages.breaks: The phone stops receiving security and system updates.

packages.name: Software update agent
packages.what: Part of the system update process.
packages.breaks: The phone may stop receiving security and system updates.

packages.name: Carrier configuration agent
packages.what: Applies your carrier's settings and apps.
packages.breaks: Carrier features may be set up wrongly after a SIM change or update.
